_comment: Department terms follow the brief's table exactly; the ten topics' terms are a first draft by Claude Code. Drives the 'Where do you work?' matching. First draft from the FPH redesign brief (4 November 2026); send each department row to its head for corrections. Search terms are matched as whole words or phrases, ignoring case; the matcher also accepts simple variants (plural -s, hyphen or space, -ise/-ize, -our/-or), so write each term once in British spelling. ERC panel codes were checked against Annex 1 'Primary Panel Structure' of the ERC Work Programme 2027 (data/ERC_Work_Programme_2027.pdf).
panel_source: ERC Work Programme 2027, Annex 1 (European Commission Decision C(2026)4907)

open_to_all_fields._comment: Calls that accept proposals from any discipline. Matched against the topic identifier, ignoring case.

teaching_and_education._comment: Calls shown to every department in the 'Teaching and education projects' group. Erasmus+ higher education cooperation partnerships (KA220-HED) are run by national agencies (DZS in Czechia) and do not appear in the portal data.

programme_sources_comment: Per department, programmes that are a main source of calls (from the brief of 5 November 2026). A call whose identifier matches gets the points and the label in 'Why this may fit you'.

departments.name: Arts Management
departments.description: Management of cultural organisations, the arts and the creative economy.
departments.panel_note: The brief listed SH5. In the 2027 structure SH5 covers literary studies, literature and philosophy, while the arts sit in SH8; SH3 (sociology, communication) is used instead for audiences and participation.
